title: Vegan Poke Bowl
description: A delicious and healthy vegan poke bowl made with Norwegian cod, mixed vegetables and a citrus vinaigrette.
instructions: Toast the seaweed sheets in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Cut the mixed vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Marinate the norwegian cod and poke in citrus vinaigrette for at least 30 minutes.
Assemble the poke bowl by placing a sheet of toasted seaweed on the bottom, followed by a scoop of marinated norwegian cod, poke, mixed vegetables, sesame seeds, and chopped green onions.
Optional: garnish with additional sesame seeds, chopped green onions, or thinly sliced citrus.
